Name: CommandGetTaxRate
Content:
<![CDATA[
declare @taxRate numeric(5, 2), @taxType int, @taxAccount varchar(32), @taxCode varchar(32)
select @taxCode = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_ma_thue_0'

end
]]>

Name: CommandCheckVoucherHandleBeforeEdit
Content:
<![CDATA[
if @@view = 0 begin
  if @@action = 'Edit' begin
    declare @$checkVoucherHandle varchar(32), @ownerID int, @fullEdit bit
    select @$checkVoucherHandle = status, @ownerID = user_id0 from @@inquiry$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
    if exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = @@id and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and xedit = 1) begin
      select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
      return
    end
    if (@@admin <> 1) and (@$checkVoucherHandle is not null) and exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = @@id and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin
      if not exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysactionrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = @@id and action_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and right_yn = 1) begin
        select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
        return
      end
      if exists(select 1 from @@sysDatabaseName..sysstatusrights where user_id = @@userID and ma_ct = @@id and status_id = @$checkVoucherHandle and r_edit = 1) begin
        select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
        return
      end
    end
		if (@@admin <> 1) and (@ownerID <> @@userID) begin
			exec @@sysDatabaseName.dbo.FastBusiness$System$GetShareAccess @@id, @@userID, @@admin, 1, @fullEdit output
			if (@fullEdit = 0) begin
				select @message as script, '$NotAuthorized' as message
				return
			end
		end
  end
end
]]>

      create table #lockedDate (r int)

        select @message as script, @$lockedDate as message

      end

    if @@admin <> 1 begin

      end
    end
  end
end

Name: UpdateCurrentStock

declare @q varchar(8000), @r tinyint

      insert into r00$$partition$current select * from ct00 where stt_rec = @stt_rec

declare @$checkVoucherHandle varchar(32), @ownerID int, @fullDelete bit
select @$checkVoucherHandle = status, @ownerID = user_id0 from @@inquiry$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
if exists(select 1 from dmttct where ma_ct = @@id and status = @$checkVoucherHandle and xdel = 1) begin

end

  end
end
if (@@admin <> 1) and (@ownerID <> @@userID) begin

  end    
end

Name: XMLGetVoucherNumber

<action id="GetVoucherNumber" ><text><![CDATA[
if exists(select 1 from v20dmnk where ma_nk = @voucherBook)
  begin
    select rtrim(ltrim(so_ct0)) as so_ct0 , rtrim(ltrim(so_ct1)) as so_ct1, rtrim(ltrim(so_ct2)) as so_ct2, rtrim(ltrim(isnull(so_seri, ''))) as ky_hieu from v20dmnk where ma_nk = @voucherBook
    return
  end    
]]></text></action>

Name: XMLGetExchangeRate
Content:
<action id="GetExchangeRate" ><text><![CDATA[
if exists(select 1 from dmtgnt where ma_nt = @ma_nt and ngay_ct <= @ngay_lct)
  select top 1 ty_gia as value from dmtgnt where ma_nt = @ma_nt and ngay_ct <= @ngay_lct order by ngay_ct desc
else
  select 0 as value
  
return
]]></text></action>

Name: XMLGetTaxRate
Content:
<action id="GetTaxRate" ><text><![CDATA[
if exists(select 1 from dmthue where ma_thue = @ma_thue)
  begin
    select a.thue_suat, rtrim(a.tk_thue_no) as tk_thue_no, isnull(b.tk_cn, 0) as thue_cn from dmthue a left join dmtk b on a.tk_thue_no = b.tk where a.ma_thue = @ma_thue
    return
  end    
]]></text></action>
